# Project Agent Guide

Overview of the project agent responsibilities. This section exists to
satisfy the purpose-header rule but the file below is deliberately bloated.

## Rules

You must always run linting before every commit in the project.
You must always run type checking before every commit in the project.
You should always run tests before every commit in the project.
You must never bypass the pre-commit hooks in the project.
You must always sign every commit with a GPG key in the project.
You must always update the changelog with every user-facing change.
You should always update the documentation with every user-facing change.
You must never merge a pull request without at least two reviewer approvals.
You must never push directly to the main branch of the project.
You should always rebase feature branches before merging into main.
You must always squash commits before merging pull requests into main.
You should always tag releases with semantic version numbers in the project.
